dedupe_keys.name: vykres koncepcie verejneho dopravneho vybavenia up ttsk

description: Výkres koncepcie verejného dopravného vybavenia ÚP TTSK is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by tiles-eu1.arcgis.com. Drawing of the concept of public transport equipment of the territorial plan of the Trnava Self-Governing Region. Coverage: SK. The portal shows the English title as "Drawing of the concept of public transport equipment of the ÚP TTSK" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Doprava, Územný plán, Kraj. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMTS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.sk). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
